title: BTST Kanban board for Next.js App Router
summary: Full-stack Kanban (boards, columns, tasks with priority and assignee, drag ordering) from the MIT BTST plugin @btst/stack 4.5.1, adopted with prerequisite checks, a scratch-copy scaffold and conflict-free file adoption instead of the scaffolder's overwrite defaults.

prerequisites.text: @tanstack/react-query is not already on another version (the tested cohort pins 5.102.0; 5.104 changes hydration)
better-auth, if the app already uses it, is the exact version the BTST adapters require (1.7.6)
next.config does not enable cacheComponents or partialPrefetching (create-next-app 16.4 turns both on; BTST's route segment config cannot build with them)
None of the paths the scaffolder writes exist yet
A sonner Toaster component (shadcn add sonner) for notifications

steps.purpose: Install the tested version set exactly, with every required @btst/stack peer in the same command; Genlib never runs the package manager.
steps.run: npm install --save-exact @btst/stack@4.5.1 @btst/yar@1.3.2 @tanstack/react-query@5.102.0 @tanstack/query-core@5.102.0 next-themes@0.4.6 better-auth@1.7.6 @better-auth/core@1.7.6 @better-auth/utils@0.4.2 @better-fetch/fetch@1.3.2 better-call@1.4.0 zod@4.6.6 ai@5.0.273 @ai-sdk/react@2.0.276 clsx@2.1.1 cmdk@1.1.1 katex@0.19.0 date-fns@4.4.0 rehype-raw@7.0.0 remark-gfm@4.0.1 remark-math@6.0.0 highlight.js@11.12.0 rehype-katex@7.0.1 react-markdown@10.1.0 tailwind-merge@3.7.0 react-hook-form@7.90.0 rehype-highlight@7.0.2 @hookform/resolvers@5.9.1 @radix-ui/react-slot@1.4.0 react-error-boundary@4.1.2 @radix-ui/react-label@2.1.16 @radix-ui/react-dialog@1.2.0 @radix-ui/react-switch@1.3.8 @tailwindcss/typography@0.5.20 @btst/adapter-kysely@3.0.0 kysely@0.29.6 pg@8.23.1
steps.note: Resolved without --legacy-peer-deps on 2026-10-11 (npm 10.9.4, Node 22.22.0) because all peers are listed exactly; leaving them to npm picks zod 3 and fails on better-call's zod 4 peer. For an evaluation with the memory adapter, replace the last three packages with @btst/adapter-memory@3.0.0.

steps.purpose: Scaffold in a scratch copy of the app, never in place: the scaffolder's --yes overwrites files.
steps.run: cp -R "$APP_ROOT" "$SCRATCH" && cp -R "$APP_ROOT" "$BASELINE" && cd "$SCRATCH" && npx @btst/codegen@4.5.1 init --framework nextjs --adapter kysely --plugins kanban --skip-install --yes

steps.purpose: Adopt only new files; identical files are kept; differing files stop the adoption; the global CSS and root layout are reported for a manual merge.

In lib/stack.ts replace `const kyselyDb = {} as never` with a real Kysely instance on PostgreSQL, keep transaction: true, and add server authorization with kanbanPermissions from @btst/stack/plugins/kanban/permissions. Without server authorization the API accepts writes from anyone. Known upstream bug: @btst/adapter-kysely@3.0.0 returns boards with no columns, because selectAllJoins looks up schema[modelKey] ('kanbanColumn') where the schema key is 'column'. Until a fixed release is pinned, the Kysely path cannot pass acceptance.
In app/pages/client-layout.tsx implement resolveUser and searchUsers from your user store, and implement or disable uploadImage.
If next.config sets cacheComponents or partialPrefetching to true (create-next-app 16.4 does), set both to false; the build otherwise fails on BTST's dynamic route segment config.
Set BTST_SITE_URL, BTST_API_URL and DATABASE_URL (production builds fail closed without trusted origins).
Create the kanbanBoard, kanbanColumn and kanbanTask tables. The CLI needs a live PostgreSQL URL (with --output too). Review the SQL first with --output.
Type-check and build, then check the API and pages (adapted from upstream e2e/tests/smoke.kanban.spec.ts) and record acceptance.

limits: Run end to end on 2026-10-11 in a create-next-app 16.4.0 fixture (next 16.4.0, React 19.3.0, Tailwind 4.3.3): check, staged plan (13 new files, 1 merge: app/globals.css) and adopt worked; the build passed after the next.config change; with the memory adapter all 18 API checks passed (boards, columns, tasks, priorities, moves, reorders, cascading delete) and the three pages rendered server-side.

With server authorization (kanbanPermissions) and an evaluation-only header identity: 401 on all 14 operations anonymously, 403 on all 12 record operations for another user, client-supplied ownerId ignored. Collection reads carry no owner facts, so a permissive collection rule lists other users' board names.

Persistence is not established with stock packages: @btst/adapter-kysely@3.0.0 drops joined columns (one-line upstream fix identified, not pinned). Prisma, which codegen wires completely, was not tried.
A duplicate board name returns HTTP 500 (unique slug violation) on PostgreSQL rather than a 4xx.
Status stays planned until a pinned, unpatched persistent adapter passes the acceptance steps.
Every BTST plugin is marked Preview upstream; versions are pinned exactly.
